headline: Elon Musk's SpaceX beats revenue expectations in debut earnings call after IPO
summary: SpaceX's revenue nearly doubled to $7.8 billion, driven by Starlink and AI growth, but capital expenditure topped $18 billion. Shares fell 7.5% after hours.
why: SpaceX is a private aerospace company that operates the Starlink satellite internet network and launches rockets for government and commercial customers. Its newly listed shares are closely watched as a gauge of investor appetite for large space and AI-linked companies.
why_moved: Revenue beat expectations, but capital expenditure of more than $18 billion weighed on sentiment, and shares fell 7.5% in after-hours trading.
